li.p: You are coding part of a first person shoother game.

li.p: Input the x coordinate of player’s shot shot_x and compare it with the targets’ x guess and compare it with the target’s borders on the x axis target_x_left and target_x_right. If the shot is within the target’s borders, output Hit!, otherwise output Miss!.
